pages.text: “Twisted power, gently tamed into a surge of energy.”$(br2)Chorus Tea is a mysterious and powerful beverage made from popped chorus fruit and milk. The soothing properties of milk neutralize the chaotic energy of chorus fruit, resulting in a tea with a bold flavor that grants a significant strength boost to travelers.

$(br2)$(br)To brew Chorus Tea, $(br)mix popped chorus fruit with milk.$(br)This tea is best consumed before battle, granting travelers increased combat power while preventing the unstable side effects of chorus fruit.

Upon drinking Chorus Tea, travelers will receive a noticeable strength boost, increasing their attack power.$(br)This tea is designed for combat and is ideal for adventurers seeking to enhance their battle prowess.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
